```artifact
Feature: Alarms

  Scenario: Alarm triggers when input air line is blocked
    Given the input air line is blocked
    When the system is running
    Then an alarm with severity HIGH is triggered

  Scenario: Alarm triggers when input O2 line is blocked
    Given the input O2 line is blocked
    When the system is running
    Then an alarm with severity HIGH is triggered

  Scenario: Alarm triggers when inspiratory pressure drops below -4cm H2O
    Given the inspiratory pressure is -5cm H2O
    When the system is running
    Then an alarm is triggered

  Scenario: Alarm triggers when input O2 line pressure is too high
    Given the input O2 line pressure is 80cm H2O
    When the system is running
    Then an alarm with severity HIGH is triggered

  Scenario: Overpressure alarm triggers above 60cm H2O
    Given the inspiratory pressure is 70cm H2O
    When the system is running
    Then an alarm is triggered

  Scenario: GUI displays an overpressure alarm
    Given the inspiratory pressure is 70cm H2O
    When the system is running
    Then the GUI displays an overpressure alarm

  Scenario: Controller triggers an alarm in case GUI is unresponsive for 1/2 of the apnea time
    Given the GUI is unresponsive for 30 seconds
    When the system is running
    Then an alarm is triggered

  Scenario: Controller triggers an alarm in case controller is unresponsive for 1/2 of the apnea time
    Given the controller is unresponsive for 30 seconds
    When the system is running
    Then an alarm is triggered

  Scenario Outline: Simultaneous alarm conditions
    Given the input air line is blocked and the input O2 line is blocked
    When the system is running
    Then an alarm with severity HIGH is triggered

  Examples:
    | input air line | input O2 line |
    | blocked        | blocked       |
    | blocked        | normal        |
    | normal         | blocked       |

  Scenario Outline: Invalid or out-of-range input values
    Given the input air line is blocked and the input O2 line pressure is 100cm H2O
    When the system is running
    Then an alarm with severity HIGH is triggered

  Examples:
    | input air line | input O2 line pressure |
    | blocked        | 100cm H2O             |
    | normal         | 100cm H2O             |
    | blocked        | -10cm H2O             |
    | normal         | -10cm H2O             |

  Scenario Outline: Alarm severity and message codes
    Given the input air line is blocked
    When the system is running
    Then the alarm severity is HIGH and the message code is "ALARM_001"

  Examples:
    | input air line | alarm severity | message code |
    | blocked        | HIGH           | ALARM_001     |
    | normal         | LOW            | ALARM_002     |

  Scenario Outline: Unresponsiveness timing
    Given the GUI is unresponsive for 30 seconds
    When the system is running
    Then the alarm is triggered after 30 seconds

  Examples:
    | unresponsiveness time |
    | 30 seconds            |
    | 1 second              |
    | 60 seconds            |

  Scenario Outline: Overpressure test uses multiple values above threshold
    Given the inspiratory pressure is 70cm H2O
    When the system is running
    Then an alarm is triggered

  Examples:
    | inspiratory pressure |
    | 70cm H2O             |
    | 80cm H2O             |
    | 90cm H2O             |
```
